title: Great Practice
content: I have been going to the Ballard's Surgery for 19 years now and every time the staff (receptionists, nurses and doctors) has always been very helpful and lovely. Thank you for all your hard work especially with limited resources and for being polite and helpful.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
